question: Approve the DRC-4595 rewrite and milestone correction for writing to Linear, and the nine acceptance criteria and declared surface as implementation's contract.

artifacts.summary: The issue's structural claims reproduce on the tree the work will land on; its numbers do not, so the stage drove the live board rather than re-reading the annotated capture. DELEGATION starts 35.2 percent into the panel rather than the filed 43.3 percent, and three figures the issue rests on are dated into history because DRC-4587 moved them. Three items are put up explicitly: the issue's own wording places the promoted composer in the chrome, which renders it on all five tabs rather than Console alone; the next-action class does not yet exist so AC-7 is written as not-yet-assessable with a named fallback; and deleting the dead project-controls path is in scope because AC-4's renders-once claim is unprovable while a second construction path stands.
